block.galacticraftcore.advanced_solar_pa: Advanced Solar Panels will collect energy from the sun, storing it for further use. Automatically adjusts panel angle for optimal energy collection. ##NEEDS TRANSLATE##
block.galacticraftcore.air_lock_frame.de: Air Lock Frames, when arranged in a portal-like formation, with a single block replaced with a controller, will function as a working air lock. ##NEEDS TRANSLATE##
block.galacticraftcore.aluminum_wire.des: Aluminum Wire is used to connect energy sources to energy consuming machines. ##NEEDS TRANSLATE##
block.galacticraftcore.arc_lamp.descript: Arc Lamps are used to provide strong light to a large area, also causing most mobs to flee. ##NEEDS TRANSLATE##
block.galacticraftcore.basic_solar_panel: Basic Solar Panels will collect energy from the sun, storing it for further use. Collects most energy at mid-day (non-adjustable). ##NEEDS TRANSLATE##
block.galacticraftcore.beam_receiver.des: Beam Receivers are connected to energy machine input and output, to transfer energy using beams. ##NEEDS TRANSLATE##
block.galacticraftcore.beam_reflector.de: Beam Reflectors are used to redirect energy beams from source to destination. Can be right-clicked to cycle through targets. ##NEEDS TRANSLATE##
block.galacticraftcore.buggy_fueling_pad: Fueling Pads will allow a buggy on the pad to be refueled by an attached Fuel Loaders if set up in a 3x3 square.  Cannot be used to launch rockets! ##NEEDS TRANSLATE##
block.galacticraftcore.cargo_loader.desc: Cargo Loaders will pass blocks and items onto Rockets and other vehicles with cargo space. Must be attached to Landing/Fueling pad. ##NEEDS TRANSLATE##
block.galacticraftcore.cargo_unloader.de: Cargo Unloaders will extract blocks and items from Rockets and other vehicles with cargo space. Must be attached to Landing/Fueling pad. ##NEEDS TRANSLATE##
block.galacticraftcore.cavernous_vines.d: Cavernous Vines are dangerous to living creatures, entangling them and dragging them upwards. ##NEEDS TRANSLATE##
block.galacticraftcore.cheese_block.desc: Cheese Blocks are created from the cheeses of the Moon, place-able and edible. ##NEEDS TRANSLATE##
block.galacticraftcore.circuit_fabricato: Circuit Fabricator will process basic materials into silicon wafers, used for advanced machines. ##NEEDS TRANSLATE##
block.galacticraftcore.coal_generator.de: Coal Generator will simply burn coal for energy collection. The simplest but least efficient energy collection method. ##NEEDS TRANSLATE##
block.galacticraftcore.comms_dish.descri: The Communications Dish can track the position of space stations and receive communications from your remote space bases. ##NEEDS TRANSLATE##
block.galacticraftcore.compressor.descri: Compressor will process ingots into their compressed equivalents. ##NEEDS TRANSLATE##
block.galacticraftcore.creeper_egg.descr: Creeper Eggs will spawn in Mars dungeons, spawning a sneaky predator upon exploding. ##NEEDS TRANSLATE##
block.galacticraftcore.cryogenic_chamber: Cryogenic Chambers will allow a player to sleep during the day, healing a small amount of health, but has a cooldown. ##NEEDS TRANSLATE##
block.galacticraftcore.display_screen.de: Display screens add that final touch to your space base. Right-click changes the information shown. ##NEEDS TRANSLATE##
block.galacticraftcore.electric_arc_furn: Arc Furnace is used as a faster alternative to both traditional coal and electric furnaces. ##NEEDS TRANSLATE##
block.galacticraftcore.electric_compress: Electric Compressor will process ingots into their compressed equivalents. Compresses two at a time, making it more effective than it's predecessor. ##NEEDS TRANSLATE##
Electric Furnace is used as a faster alternative to traditional coal furnaces. ##NEEDS TRANSLATE##
block.galacticraftcore.electrolyzer.desc: Transforms water into hydrogen (useful for the Methane Synthesizer) and oxygen. ##NEEDS TRANSLATE##
block.galacticraftcore.enclosed.descript: Sealable blocks should be used where air cannot pass, such as space base walls. ##NEEDS TRANSLATE##
block.galacticraftcore.energy_storage_cl: Energy Storage Cluster is used to store large amounts of energy for later use. Stores and outputs more energy than it's predecessor. ##NEEDS TRANSLATE##
block.galacticraftcore.energy_storage_mo: Energy Storage Module is used to store large amounts of energy for later use. ##NEEDS TRANSLATE##
block.galacticraftcore.fallen_meteor.des: Fallen Meteors can be found in many planets/moons which have little or no atmosphere. Will drop Meteoric Iron when broken. ##NEEDS TRANSLATE##
block.galacticraftcore.fuel_loader.descr: After being connected to a launch pad, a Fuel Loader will allow fuel to passed into the connected Rocket or other vehicle. ##NEEDS TRANSLATE##
block.galacticraftcore.gas_liquefier.des: Liquefies gases, either from the atmosphere or from canisters. Liquefied methane makes a good rocket fuel! ##NEEDS TRANSLATE##
block.galacticraftcore.glowstone_torch.d: Glowstone Torches are best used to light areas when there is no oxygen for wood torches to burn. ##NEEDS TRANSLATE##
block.galacticraftcore.heavy_aluminum_wi: Heavy Aluminum Wire is used to connect energy sources to energy consuming machines. Transfers at a faster rate than it's predecessor. ##NEEDS TRANSLATE##
block.galacticraftcore.landing_pad.descr: Landing Pads will allow placement of Rockets if set up in a 3x3 square. Fuel Loaders, Cargo Loaders, and Launch Controllers can be attached. ##NEEDS TRANSLATE##
block.galacticraftcore.launch_controller: Launch Controllers are used to customize launch behaviour, including launch criteria and destination launch pad for auto launches. ##NEEDS TRANSLATE##
block.galacticraftcore.methane_synthesiz: With a source of hydrogen and a source of carbon, this manufactures Methane for further processing in a Gas Liquefier. ##NEEDS TRANSLATE##
block.galacticraftcore.miner_base.descri: The Astro Miner Base is the docking point for an Astro Miner.  It's big ... try making a 2 x 2 x 2 cube with these. ##NEEDS TRANSLATE##
block.galacticraftcore.nasa_workbench.de: The NASA Workbench is used to create many advanced parts and vehicles. New schematics can be added as they are found. ##NEEDS TRANSLATE##
Oxygen Collector will store oxygen collected from leaves in the surrounding area. ##NEEDS TRANSLATE##
block.galacticraftcore.oxygen_compressor: Oxygen Compressor will load oxygen from internal storage into an oxygen tank. ##NEEDS TRANSLATE##
block.galacticraftcore.oxygen_decompress: Oxygen Decompressor will unload oxygen into internal storage from an oxygen tank. ##NEEDS TRANSLATE##
block.galacticraftcore.oxygen_detector.d: Oxygen Detector will emit a redstone signal when surrounded by oxygen. ##NEEDS TRANSLATE##
block.galacticraftcore.oxygen_distributo: Oxygen Distributor will emit an oxygen bubble outwards from the center block, using internal tank. This allows safe breathing inside the bubble. ##NEEDS TRANSLATE##
block.galacticraftcore.oxygen_sealer.des: Oxygen Sealer will check for an enclosed space. If one is found, the area will fill with breathable air. ##NEEDS TRANSLATE##
block.galacticraftcore.oxygen_storage_mo: Oxygen Storage Module is used to store large amounts of oxygen for later use. ##NEEDS TRANSLATE##
block.galacticraftcore.parachest.descrip: Parachests will fall from the sky after landing on certain planets/moons, such as Earth. Contains rocket, fuel, and cargo from previous launch. ##NEEDS TRANSLATE##
block.galacticraftcore.refinery.descript: Refinery will take an input of oil and energy, and output fuel used for rockets and vehicles. ##NEEDS TRANSLATE##
block.galacticraftcore.short_range_telep: Système de téléportation à courte portée
Short Range Telepads are used to transfer players and other living creatures short distances (250 Blocks) when linked to other telepads. ##NEEDS TRANSLATE##
block.galacticraftcore.slimeling_egg.des: Slimeling Eggs, once cracked with a player's bare hands, will soon hatch into a pet. ##NEEDS TRANSLATE##
block.galacticraftcore.spin_thruster.des: Spin Thrusters are used to make space stations rotate. ##NEEDS TRANSLATE##
block.galacticraftcore.telemetry.descrip: This gathers useful data from linked rockets, players and mobs. Best placed near to a Display Screen. Use a Frequency Module to establish data links. ##NEEDS TRANSLATE##
block.galacticraftcore.telepad_fake: Système de téléportation à courte portée
block.galacticraftcore.terraformer.descr: Terraformers are used to add some greenery to distant planets, adding grass, trees and water when given the correct materials. ##NEEDS TRANSLATE##
block.galacticraftcore.treasure_chest_ti: Tier 1 Treasure Chests will generate in Moon Dungeons. They are unlockable after defeating the final boss. ##NEEDS TRANSLATE##
Tier 2 Treasure Chests will generate in Mars Dungeons. They are unlockable after defeating the final boss. ##NEEDS TRANSLATE##
Tier 3 Treasure Chests are currently unused. ##NEEDS TRANSLATE##
block.galacticraftcore.walkway.descripti: Walkways are used for decorative purposes, used for connecting blocks while maintaining a space theme. ##NEEDS TRANSLATE##
block.galacticraftcore.walkway_pipe.desc: Oxygen Pipe Walkways are used for running pipes underneath a fully solid walkable surface. ##NEEDS TRANSLATE##
block.galacticraftcore.walkway_wire.desc: Aluminum Wire Walkways are used for running wire underneath a fully solid walkable surface. ##NEEDS TRANSLATE##
